items.summary: Flow policies are among the strongest robot controllers and are well suited to modelling multimodal action distributions. We challenge this assumption empirically by measuring whether performance-optimized code produced by LLM self-refinement pipelines is also energy-efficient relative to canonical human reference solutions, and whether the energy cost of the optimization process can be offset by subsequent execution-time savings.
